rachel: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem. We need clear owners for: token refresh validation hardening, audit-event coverage for deletion, and a secrets rotation cadence. Short sync to lock ETAs.

Tom: I'll own token validation. Plan: add stricter parsing, unit + integration tests, and a migration to mark bad persisted tokens. ETA 9 days.

Anya: I'll take audit events and dashboards. Will emit `audit.token.deleted` and ensure index retention + RBAC. ETA 4 days.

devops-bot: Note: KMS rotation canary window scheduled on staging 2026-06-01.

rachel: For secrets rotation, Anya can coordinate with infra for canary keys; I'll draft quarterly vs monthly policy in the runbook.

Tom: Adding quick repro for flaky refresh rejects to INF-8344 and adding fuzz harness. Snippet:
```
ERROR auth: validation fail: no kid
payload: {"alg":"none","sub":"svc"}
```

anya: I'll attach dashboard link to AUD-8345 and add query to surface missing delete events. Also will add alert `audit.missing_delete` to #sec-audit.

rachel: Action summary: INF-8344 (tom) token validation  9d; AUD-8345 (anya) audit coverage  4d; RUNBOOK-23 (rachel/infra) rotation policy  2w. Weekly check-in Fridays 10:00. Everyone ack?

tom: Ack.

anya: Ack, will ping infra for KMS soak.

audit-bot: Channel #sec-audit created for alerts.

rachel: Thanks team, I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and slide ETAs into the sprint backlog. :thumbsup:
